study_name.notes: No explicit study name provided; study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02217384

target_condition.evidence_quote: Anorexia nervosa (AN) is an eating disorder with a high mortality.

country.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases, recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark

body_site.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples, respectively

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: DNA extraction from aliquots of faecal samples was performed following IHMS SOP P7 V2
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Faecal sample collection and DNA extraction
dna_extraction_kit.notes: NucleoSpin soil mini kit (MACHEREY-NAGEL) used in mouse experiments per Methods section

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: Purified and amplified DNA fragment libraries were sequenced using the Ion Proton Sequencer

age_unit.evidence_quote: three patients with AN (females aged 20, 22 and 20 yr
age_unit.notes: Age reported in years (yr) throughout the paper

sex.evidence_quote: AN primarily affects women in about 95% of cases
sex.notes: Study included only females: 'we decided to include only women in the present study'

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months

antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.evidence_quote: antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months

ancestry.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases

ancestry_details.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women

westernized.evidence_quote: study uses Danish population from specialized healthcare centres
westernized.notes: Inferred from recruitment in Denmark via specialized medical centres

age_min.notes: Study reports age-matched recruitment and specific donor ages (20, 22, 20 yr for AN; 20, 22, 21 yr for HC in FMT), but no minimum age cutoff stated for main cohort.

age_max.notes: No maximum age cutoff explicitly reported for the main human cohort of 77 AN and 70 HC participants.

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Exclusion criterion was antibiotic treatment within prior 3 months; implies current use excluded at enrollment.

bmi.evidence_quote: BMI below 18.5 or above 25 kg m⁻¹ −² [exclusion for HC]; women with AN were much leaner
bmi.notes: HC had BMI 18.5–25 by inclusion criteria. AN cases characterized as 'much leaner' but specific BMI range not provided in main text; FMT donors reported specific BMIs (10.3, 11.5, 11.7 for AN; 22.6, 21.1, 21.2 for HC).

disease.evidence_quote: AN patients were all diagnosed by an experienced consultant psychiatrist and they met the DSM-5 criteria for the restricting or binge/purging subtypes of AN
disease.notes: Diagnosis confirmed by consultant psychiatrist using DSM-5 criteria; HC were healthy individuals without reported disease.

disease_details.evidence_quote: It can be classified into two subtypes, the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type
disease_details.notes: AN cohort comprised AN-RS (n=56) and AN-BP (n=21) subtypes.

feces_phenotype.evidence_quote: AN microbiota samples were characterized by a reduction in Bacteroidota and Actinobacteriota
feces_phenotype.notes: Stool samples collected from AN and HC; FMT study showed that AN stool recipients displayed reduced weight gain and altered gene expression.

fmt_id.evidence_quote: Faecal samples from randomly selected subsets of three patients with AN and three HC were used to colonize 6-week-old female GF littermates
fmt_id.notes: Three AN donors and three HC donors used; study-specific identifiers not explicitly provided but referenced as donor source for litter-specific transplantations.

fmt_role.evidence_quote: Faecal samples from randomly selected subsets of three patients with AN and three HC were used to colonize 6-week-old female GF littermates
fmt_role.notes: Human participants (AN cases and HC) provided stool samples; germ-free mice were recipients.

smoker.notes: Smoking status was included as a covariate in analyses (age, BMI, smoking, medication), but no summary of smoking distribution in cohort is provided.

treatment.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria for the age-matched healthy control women were BMI below 18.5 or above 25 kg m −1 −2 , regular medication of any kind apart from birth control pills, and antibiotics within the last 3 months. All the included patients were treated in specialized centres.
treatment.notes: AN cases received multidisciplinary treatment including cognitive behavioural therapy; specific medications (SSRIs, antipsychotics, benzodiazepines) were included as covariates in analyses. HC excluded if taking regular medications except birth control.

obgyn_birth_control.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria for the age-matched healthy control women were BMI below 18.5 or above 25 kg m −1 −2 , regular medication of any kind apart from birth control pills
obgyn_birth_control.notes: HC were allowed to use birth control pills (not excluded), but individual usage not reported. AN group medication status not specifically addressed for oral contraceptives.

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: Multiple bacterial taxa (for example, Clostridium species) were altered in AN
biomarker_name.notes: Biomarkers identified as altered in AN cases versus healthy controls across bacterial taxa, serum metabolites, and functional modules.

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: serum concentrations of both primary and secondary bile acids were higher in AN
biomarker_unit.notes: Units vary by biomarker type; generally expressed as relative abundance, serum concentration, or circulating levels.

value: positively correlated with eating disorder scores
inversely correlated with eating disorder scores
biomarker_value.evidence_quote: Clostridium species were positively correlated with eating disorder scores
biomarker_value.section: Results — Associations between absolute bacterial abundance
biomarker_value.notes: Specific quantitative values not provided for most biomarkers in aggregate; values characterized directionally as increased/decreased or enriched/depleted.

disease_response_os.notes: Overall survival is not a relevant endpoint in this microbiota and metabolomics study of anorexia nervosa.

disease_response_os_unit.notes: Not applicable; study does not report survival data.

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status is not assessed in this microbiota study.

value: higher β-diversity at species level in AN
reduction in viral–bacterial interactions in AN

feces_phenotype_value.notes: Fecal/stool microbiota phenotypes include diversity metrics, taxonomic composition changes, and viral-bacterial interaction alterations.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Tumor measurements are not relevant to this anorexia nervosa microbiota study.

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable; this study does not involve tumor assessment.
